intro.text: An Idrian slumlord in T'Telir, nicknamed the Gentleman Idrian, who makes his living from brothels.

items.text: A contact of Denth's and a former backer of Vahr's rebellion, Paxen is well connected in the Idrian slums. He meets Vivenna and Denth along with Rira and Ashu to talk about stirring up unrest in the city, but cares more about profit than about his king's cause, and wants firm commitments before he will help.

appearance.text: He wears showy, bright clothing and carries a fine cane, at ease in both despite the beliefs of his homeland. He has reached at least the First Heightening, another taboo in Idris.
